#BrightTable 1.4 "Betta Meta" is released...

(Linux desktop app connecting #Immich to your favorite #opensource raw editors).

New features:
1. Lens editing including stored lenses, and mapping to existing lens EXIF. For the vintage lens shooters.
 
2. Edit date and time including time zone, and offsets.

3. Full screen mode

4. Faster, higher-resolution RAW previews using the JPEG embedded in the RAW file.

5. Enhancements to loupe in detail and full screen mode
